App.title: VectorAdmin
App.description: Cross-program adoption and data-quality metrics for VectorCam

Auth.title: Sign in to VectorAdmin
Auth.subtitle: Use your VectorCam account.
Auth.loginError: Sign-in failed. The email or password may be incorrect.
Auth.accessCheckError: Could not check your access. Refresh the page to try again.

NoAccess.title: No access
NoAccess.description: VectorAdmin is open to VectorCam developer accounts only. Your account is signed in but does not have developer access.
NoAccess.switchAccount: Sign in with a different account

Dashboard.heading: Program metrics
Dashboard.loadError: Could not load the dashboard. Refresh the page to try again.
Dashboard.failedPrograms: Could not load {names}. Their rows are marked failed and totals are incomplete.
Dashboard.noProgramsSelected: No programs selected. Choose at least one program.

activeDevices.title: Active Devices
activeDevices.description: Devices with at least one Session collected in the period, each counted once however many months it was active. Only Surveillance and Data collection Sessions count; Practice and Calibration are ignored.

images.title: Images
images.description: Every photo of a Specimen from Surveillance and Data collection Sessions, counted in the month the Session was collected (Program's timezone). A Specimen photographed three times counts three times.

uniqueSpecimens.title: Unique Specimens
uniqueSpecimens.description: Specimens from Surveillance and Data collection Sessions collected in the period, each counted once however many Images it has.

imagesPerActiveDevice.title: Images per Active Device
imagesPerActiveDevice.description: Images ÷ Active Devices, for the same Programs and period. Blank when no devices were active.

metadataCompleteness.title: Metadata Completeness
metadataCompleteness.description: Share of Specimens whose record has all four: a species, a capture date, Session GPS inside the Program's country, and an operator name. Open a Program's row to see each field.

dhis2UploadRate.title: DHIS2 Upload Rate
dhis2UploadRate.description: Submitted ÷ (Certified + Submitted) Sessions collected in the period. A failed or never-attempted upload stays Certified. Uganda only; blank for other Programs, which don't use DHIS2.

uniqueUsers.title: Unique Users
uniqueUsers.description: VectorVerify users (reviewers, not field collectors) who logged in during the period, each counted once. Uses UTC months. Blank before login tracking began.

logins.title: Logins
logins.description: Every VectorVerify login during the period, all users. Uses UTC months. Blank before login tracking began.

Summary.heading: Summary, {period}
Summary.noCountryBoxHint: No bounding box for this Program's country, so geolocation always fails.
Summary.toggleFields: Show field completeness and locations for {program}
Summary.inProgressHint: {month} hasn't ended yet, so its numbers are still coming in.

Devices.counts: {total} registered · {active} active · {inactive} inactive · {neverUsed} never used · {bySite} placed by Site · {unplaced} without a location

unplaced.heading: Devices without a location ({count})
unplaced.description: No in-country GPS fix, and their Site could not be geocoded (yet).
unplaced.empty: Every used device is on the map.

Sessions.title: {program} · {period}
Sessions.summary: {count, plural, one {# Session} other {# Sessions}}, {uncertified} not yet certified. Uncertified first, oldest first.
Sessions.loadError: Could not load Sessions. Try again.

MapFilters.notRecordedAbdomen: No abdomen status on record: the app did not predict one and no reviewer has set one. Always the case for males.
